##### Project general facts

Rosso Bay Residences by Aldar is a branded beachfront community within a five-star resort destination, designed for relaxed coastal living. Three residential buildings, each made up of two connected structures, rise from a ground floor to between twenty-one and twenty-three residential floors. Interiors are styled in warm beige, light grey and wood tones with vibrant red accents. The collection offers one-, two-, three- and four-bedroom apartments and four-bedroom penthouses, available furnished and unfurnished.

Residents enjoy direct beach access, a beach clubhouse, a beach lounge and beach sports, together with a swimming pool, a splash pad and relaxing gardens. Indoor amenities include a gym with dance and yoga studio, a sauna and treatment room, a library, a family lounge, a games room and a co-working space, while an outdoor gym, a yoga deck, indoor and outdoor kids' play areas, a food and beverage retail strip and convenience retail complete the offer.

Spacious apartments feature habitable balconies, smart automated blinds and a residents' app, and selected units are ready for short-term rental. The community is pet friendly and pursues wellness and sustainability certifications, with air quality, noise and environmental indicators monitored on site, electric vehicle chargers and bicycle parking. Round-the-clock concierge, valet parking and housekeeping are complemented by a la carte services. Homes are delivered fully furnished, with unfurnished options also available.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Marjan Island is a group of reclaimed coral-shaped islands off the coast of Ras Al Khaimah, known for its pristine beaches, turquoise waters and resort atmosphere. The Wynn Al Marjan Island integrated resort, DoubleTree by Hilton and Rixos Bab Al Bahr sit alongside beach clubs, restaurants and waterfront promenades, creating a lively coastal setting for residents and visitors throughout the year.

Al Hamra Village, with its golf course, marina and mall, is a short drive away, and Mina Al Arab is also close by. Ras Al Khaimah International Airport is easily reached, while Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road connects residents with Sharjah, Dubai and Dubai International Airport, keeping the wider region within comfortable driving distance for business and leisure, while schools and clinics serve families nearby.

Al Marjan Island is a freehold destination open to international buyers, with full foreign ownership and no personal income tax. The arrival of the Wynn integrated resort is driving strong growth in tourism, hospitality and short-term rental demand across the island. Branded beachfront residences in a managed resort community appeal to both investors seeking rental income and buyers looking for a coastal second home.
